D=/tmp/morph/score-judge-v5; mkdir -p $D; S=$(date +%s)
cp tests/test_score_examples.py $D/0-$S.py 2>/dev/null
(
 set -e
 venv/bin/python -c "import ast,sys; [ast.parse(open(f).read(), f, feature_version=(3,9)) for f in sys.argv[1:]]" tests/test_score_examples.py
 venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_score_examples.py -q --tb=short
 venv/bin/python decks/v5_guard.py tests/test_score_examples.py --quotes 12 --hashes 3 --tests 3 --lines 71,81,82,102,111,119,120 --max 60
 cat > $D/m1.py <<'EOF'
_m_score = score_expertise
def score_expertise(profile, stats):
    record = _m_score(profile, stats)
    record["expertise_score"] = profile.get("followers", 0) + 2 * stats.get("total_stars", 0)
    return record
EOF
 cat > $D/m2.py <<'EOF'
import math as _m_math
_m_score2 = score_expertise
def score_expertise(profile, stats):
    record = _m_score2(profile, stats)
    record["expertise_score"] = round(200 * _m_math.log10(profile.get("followers", 0) + 1) + 100 * _m_math.log10(stats.get("total_stars", 0) + 1))
    return record
EOF
 R=$PWD
 mut() { T=$(mktemp -d); cp -r megatron tests decks $T/
  case "$2" in append:*) cat "${2#append:}" >> $T/$1;; *) sed -i "$2" $T/$1;; esac
  if cmp -s $1 $T/$1; then echo "MUTANT NOT APPLIED: $2"; exit 1; fi
  if (cd $T && $R/venv/bin/python -m pytest $3 -q --tb=no -p no:cacheprovider); then echo "MUTANT SURVIVED: $2 -- $4"; exit 1; fi
  echo "mutant killed: $2"; }
 mut megatron/processors.py append:$D/m1.py "tests/test_score_examples.py" "a processors.py that returns the old linear score passes; the test must assert the new value 1635/90"
 mut megatron/processors.py append:$D/m2.py "tests/test_score_examples.py" "a processors.py with the weights swapped (torvalds 1644, minnow 181) passes; the test must assert exactly 1635 and 90"
 venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -q --tb=short --ignore-glob='*score-judge-v5*'
) > $D/acc.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat $D/acc.log; exit $rc
